svg.text: Version 2.1 + grid taps + Filter Taps + LP/HP filter. One delay line per channel; the stereo image is made afterwards, by the tap matrix.
DelayLine::process() — the processor holds two, mDelayL and mDelayR
TAP-TO-TAP REGENERATION — when Taps FB is on
each tap × Loop Scale × its handle on the tap scope, added in where the tap before it reads (tap 1: the write head)
Filter Taps — a ladder per tap (same mode), + dither, × Filter Gain
only with Filter Taps AND this side's Filter On; otherwise passed straight through
Filter Off: tap 5 goes this way, like taps 1–4
FILTER PATH — tap 5, when this side's Filter On (the DXi's own filter)
MAIN FEEDBACK — when Main FB is on
taken after Filter Gain, before FB Out; filter off: the raw tap 5
Filter Taps only changes what is HEARD from taps 1–4: the line itself, and both feedback paths, never see those filters.
SpaceDubProcessor::processAudio() — carried over from the DXi unchanged

g.text: = the bar FRAMES on the scope

svg.text: Enabled off, or Bypass on: the input passes straight through.
C · What the tap scope's marks are
one tap, both sides — left above the axis, right below

g.text: Amber handle = TAP FEEDBACK, not volume.
The × Tn fb pills in A: how much of this tap regenerates into the tap before it.
0–200 %, 100 % = the DXi (dim tick). Shown only while Taps FB is on; follows Link (Loop Scale).
Bright fill = the tap's level now (meter, dBFS).
Measured after Taps Gain / FB Out and any filter, before the matrix — and whether or not
Taps Out lets the tap be heard (unheard taps are drawn dimmed).
Frame = the share heard on its own side;
small frame across the axis = the share crossing to the other side. Panel B's fixed matrix.
LP / HP = this tap is filtered, and how
tap 5 with Filter On; taps 1–4 as well with Filter Taps. Position on the time axis = the tap's delay.

svg.text: The tap volumes are the green controls, per side, never per tap:
Taps Gain — taps 1–4, and tap 5 when its filter is off · FB Out — tap 5 through the filter
Taps Out — taps 1–4 in or out · Dry — the input. Each tap's own L/R split is fixed (B).
d = Delay. Free-running the taps sit at n × d; with Sync Rate on they sit on the grid (U = one sync step, echo = N U, taps 4…1 halve down from the power of two below N).
